inputs.raw_checkpoint_inventory: The 152 JSON and 152 NPZ files in the frozen J15 postprocess manifest; read-only and not copied by this replay.

allowed: validate the J15 run state, frequency count, field schema, and point statuses
generate one amplitude/phase figure into the new replay_002 output path
write a manifest with input and output hashes and route-status counts
prohibited: changing J14/J15 artifacts, contracts, ledgers, or statuses

criteria.input_integrity: Input SHA-256 equals the frozen value before and after plotting.
criteria.status_integrity: The source run remains PYTEST_FAILED; all 151 row-level qf_route_status values remain unchanged and are represented in the output manifest.
criteria.schema: All 151 QF and reference rows have aligned frequencies and the expected explicit amplitude and phase fields.
criteria.output: A nonempty PNG is created in replay_002 and its SHA-256 is recorded.
criteria.scientific_status: Recovered exploratory data only; no QF route point is promoted and no mechanical PASS is claimed.

resources.estimate: One JSON input, 151 rows, one Matplotlib PNG, and one small manifest; no FEM assembly or solver call.

status_policy: The source J15 run and per-frequency route statuses remain unchanged; the replay does not create a new FEM attempt.
